about_the_game:
This demo will be updated regularly.

Set in an alternate history where the empires of Kemet (Ancient Nubia-Egypt) remained unconquered, the Kemet X Demo offers a first glimpse into a world where ancient power meets futuristic warfare. Experience fast-paced space battles, third-person melee combat, and educational segments that uncover the rich history and languages of Ancient Nubia and Egypt.

Step into the world of warrior-prince Jaraqo and face the tyranny of Lord Isfet, a galactic overlord threatening the future of Kemet's interstellar empire

Key Features in the Demo:

✔️ Fast-Paced Space Combat – Pilot a spacecraft and engage in explosive combat across the Kemet X galaxy.

✔️ Third-Person Melee Combat – Fight on foot as warrior-prince Jaraqo, using weapons, tactics, and abilities.

✔️ Educational Segments – Learn about the real history of Ancient Nubia and Egypt, their rulers and enduring legacies.

✔️ Ancient Languages – Experience Nobiin, one of the world’s most ancient living languages, through in-game segments designed to preserve and showcase Africa’s linguistic heritage.

✔️ Rich Sci-Fi Setting – Explore an Afrofuturistic vision of Kemet, blending mythology, advanced technology, and interstellar warfare.

✔️ PC & VR Support – Play in PC mode or VR via Virtual Desktop for a fully immersive experience, using an Xbox controller or keyboard. For the best performance, we recommend playing in VR on a large screen via Virtual Desktop with an Ethernet connection.

 ✔️ A solo-developed creation: Crafted by indie developer Theo Dusu, Kemet X delivers a captivating journey with an unforgettable ending.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6600K / AMD FX-6300 (or any 4-core, ~3.5GHz CPU)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 (or 750 Ti) / AMD Radeon HD 7770 (or R7 260X) – 1–2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Direct X Compatible
  • VR Support: Optimised for VR via Virtual Desktop - Kemet X is not optimised for SteamVR. To play in VR, please use a big screen via Virtual Desktop, which supports Meta Quest 2, Quest 3, Quest Pro, and Pico headsets. Additionally, a gamepad or keyboard is required for input, as VR motion controllers are not supported.
  • Additional Notes: Integrated graphics (Intel HD, Iris) might run the game at lower settings/resolution but are not recommended for a smooth experience. If playing with a gamepad, you may occasionally need to visit websites. In such cases, you will revert to using a keyboard and mouse.

short_description: Play as warrior-prince Jaraqo, command your spacecraft and embark on interstellar travel across the Kemet X galaxy. Battle galactic overlord, Lord Isfet.
